roleContext.jobDescription: We provide cleaning, maintenance and grounds services to around 70 office and retail sites in the region. The Facilities Compliance Coordinator keeps the statutory inspection calendar for lifts, fire alarms, gas appliances and water systems, audits subcontractor permits to work, investigates site incidents with the area managers and prepares the quarterly compliance report that goes to each client. Clients audit our safety arrangements every year, so the coordinator must hold a recognised certificate-level occupational health and safety qualification. The post reports to the regional operations manager.

requirements.text: Maintains the statutory inspection calendar and chases overdue inspections with contractors.
Audits subcontractor permits to work and method statements before work starts.
Investigates site incidents with area managers and records corrective actions to closure.
Prepares the quarterly compliance report for client account managers.
Holds the NEBOSH National General Certificate or an equivalent certificate-level health and safety qualification.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Facilities Compliance Coordinator

## Experience

- Compliance Administrator, Brackenridge Facility Services (March 2022 to August 2026): kept the statutory inspection calendar for 48 client sites in the CAFM system and chased contractors whenever a lift, fire-alarm or gas-safety inspection passed its due date.
- Checked subcontractor permits to work for roof access and hot works against the method statement before the job was released, and returned incomplete permits to the contractor with the missing items marked.
- Worked on incident investigations with the area managers, interviewing site staff, photographing the scene and entering the corrective actions in the incident log, then following each action until it was closed.
- Scheduled the monthly toolbox talks for cleaning operatives across the northern sites and filed the signed attendance sheets.
- Site Receptionist, Lyle Street Business Centre (June 2019 to February 2022): managed visitor sign-in and contractor inductions and kept the fire-warden rota up to date.

## Work samples

- Work sample: an anonymised incident investigation file for a slip on a wet floor at a retail site, containing the timeline, witness notes, root cause (warning signage removed during cleaning), the corrective actions and the area manager's closure sign-off.
